package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// The Queries struct here is declared inside a function body, so its *ast.TypeSpec is not a
// top-level file.Decls entry and a walker that iterated file.Decls never inspected its fields
// -- even though this shape embeds *pgxpool.Pool and so promotes Query/Exec/SendBatch straight
// onto it. Only a whole-file ast.Inspect reaches the declaration.
func scaffold(pool *pgxpool.Pool) any {
	type Queries struct {
		*pgxpool.Pool
		scopes Scopes
	}
	return &Queries{Pool: pool}
}
